name: novaforge-panel
description: Read-only viewer for NovaForge runs. Reads the files the pipeline already writes; launches nothing, calls no model, writes nothing.

scripts.build: npm run index:runs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.render-check: vite build --ssr ssr-check.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/ssr-check.js
